lesson.title: The regions of Morocco
beat.intro.title: The regions of Morocco
beat.intro.narration: The regions of Morocco. [[n]]Since twenty fifteen, Morocco has had twelve regions.
node.tc.title: The regions of Morocco
beat.where.title: Where is Morocco?
beat.where.narration: Morocco is in north-west Africa, [[sea]]between the Mediterranean Sea to the north and the Atlantic Ocean to the west. [[rabat]]Its capital is Rabat.
node.m1.highlight.0.label: Morocco
node.m1.markers.0.label: Rabat
beat.twelve.title: Twelve regions
beat.twelve.narration: These are the twelve regions. [[casa]]Casablanca-Settat has the most people, [[mar]]followed to the south by Marrakech-Safi, [[souss]]then Souss-Massa, whose capital is Agadir. [[south]]And in the south, Laâyoune-Sakia El Hamra.
node.m2.regions.highlight.0.label: Casablanca-Settat
node.m2.regions.highlight.1.label: Marrakech-Safi
node.m2.regions.highlight.2.label: Souss-Massa
node.m2.regions.highlight.3.label: Laâyoune-Sakia El Hamra
beat.q1.title: Quick check
beat.q1.narration: Quick check. Where is the Souss-Massa region?
q.souss.prompt: Click the Souss-Massa region on the map.
q.souss.explain: Souss-Massa lies on the Atlantic Ocean, south of Marrakech-Safi; its capital is Agadir.
q.souss.wrong.r:0: That is Casablanca-Settat, in the middle of the Atlantic coast.
q.souss.wrong.r:1: That is the Oriental region, near the Algerian border.
q.souss.wrong.r:3: That is Dakhla-Oued Ed-Dahab, in the far south.
beat.wrap.title: Remember
beat.wrap.narration: Let's remember. [[a]]Morocco has twelve regions, [[b]]each with its own capital, [[c]]and the one with the most people is Casablanca-Settat.
node.sum.items.1.text: Each region has a capital, such as Agadir for Souss-Massa
beat.finish.title: The end
beat.finish.narration: Well done! The lesson is over.
